report_name: Ransomware Group 'TheGentlemen' Lists Polish Industrial Firm Agapit as Victim

threat_actors.name: TheGentlemen
threat_actors.description: A ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operator that claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Agapit by listing the company on its dark web data leak site on July 24, 2026. The group is described as the seventh most prolific ransomware group between March 2025 and March 2026.
threat_actors.goals: Data exfiltration and extortion of victim companies for financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: TheGentlemen group listed Agapit on its data leak site as part of a double extortion strategy, using the threat of a public data leak to pressure the company into paying a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: TheGentlemen group exfiltrated sensitive data from Agapit's network to attacker-controlled cloud storage as part of their double extortion attack.

identities.name: Agapit
identities.description: An industrial equipment company based in Poland, listed as a victim on TheGentlemen ransomware group's data leak site on July 24, 2026.

infrastructure.name: TheGentlemen Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by TheGentlemen ransomware group to list victims and leak their exfiltrated data to extort ransom payments. Agapit was listed on this site.

indicators.name: Suspicious Archive File Creation for Data Staging
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Archive File Creation for Data Staging
id: 2b8c1f9a-4a7d-4e8c-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of archive files (.zip, .7z, .rar) which could indicate data staging before exfiltration, a common tactic used by ransomware groups like TheGentlemen.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.zip'
      - '.7z'
      - '.rar'
  filter_legit_paths:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - 'C:\Users\'
      - 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Definition Updates\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_paths
indicators.description: Detects the creation of large archive files, which can be a precursor to data exfiltration as used by ransomware groups.

indicators.name: Rclone Execution for Data Exfiltration
indicators.pattern:
title: Rclone Execution for Potential Data Exfiltration
id: 8d9e0f1a-2b3c-4d5e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool often abused by ransomware groups for data exfiltration to cloud storage services.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'copy'
      - 'sync'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool commonly used by threat actors for exfiltrating large volumes of data to cloud storage.
